$comment: SDK conventions layered on top of the connector-js oracle. The generator applies these when emitting src/types/convert.wave8.types.ts. Every entry needs a reason — this file is the review surface for deliberate divergences from the upstream OpenAPI typing.

numericStringFields.$comment: Oracle types these as string; the SDK's established convention (Wave 1, asserted by test/resources/ConvertAndAlgo.test.ts) transforms decimal-amount strings to number at the parse boundary so consumers get numeric amounts. Overrides are applied by field name across all interfaces of this product.

flexibleIdFields.$comment: Oracle types these as number|bigint (current upstream OpenAPI), but Binance's own docs examples and the wire have historically returned string ids on this surface (the pre-catalog docs typed orderId as string). The SDK's established public type is string, so these parse with z.coerce.string() — accepting both wire forms, emitting the established type.

AcceptQuoteResponse.$comment: The wire returns the full conversion detail on acceptQuote. The current upstream OpenAPI models only orderId/createTime/orderStatus (trimmed when Binance migrated Convert docs to the core-trading-convert catalog). Keeping the richer established shape is non-breaking and matches observed responses; drop after the next wire verification if Binance really trims it.
